import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Ensure the manually created dataset is initialized
data_manual = {
    "Student_ID": [101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109, 110],
    "Age": [18, 21, 19, 22, 20, 18, 21, 23, 19, 22],
    "Gender": ["Female", "Male", "Male", "Female", "Female", "Male", "Female", "Male", "Female", "Male"],
    "Academic_Year": [1, 3, 2, 4, 2, 1, 3, 4, 2, 4],
    "Study_Hours_Day": [4, 6, 3, 8, 5, 2, 7, 9, 4, 6],
    "Sleep_Hours_Day": [7, 6, 5, 8, 7, 4, 6, 5, 8, 6],
    "Stress_Level": ["Medium", "High", "Low", "High", "Medium", "High", "Low", "High", "Low", "Medium"],
    "Extra_Activities": ["Yes", "No", "Yes", "No", "Yes", "No", "Yes", "Yes", "No", "Yes"],
    "CGPA": [3.2, 3.8, 2.9, 3.9, 3.5, 2.4, 3.6, 3.7, 3.1, 3.4],
    "Depression_Status": ["No", "Yes", "No", "Yes", "No", "Yes", "No", "Yes", "No", "No"]
}
df_student = pd.DataFrame(data_manual)

# Visual representation using a styled Count Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(data=df_student, x="Depression_Status", hue="Gender", palette="pastel")
plt.title("Distribution of Depression Status by Gender (10 Sample Cohort)")
plt.xlabel("Depression Status")
plt.ylabel("Count of Students")
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.legend(title="Gender")
plt.show()
